connection.s_connection.title: CCU connection
connection.s_connection.credentialsNotic: Device and room names come from the CCU WebUI. Enter a WebUI user (Admin by default). If the WebUI has no login, leave the password empty. Without a user, devices are listed by their address.
connection.s_connection.host.label: Host / IP
connection.s_connection.host.description: Filled when one CCU is found. Type the address if it is not.

connection.s_callback.title: Event callback
connection.s_callback.description: Optional; must be reachable from the CCU (not 127.0.0.1). Blank auto-infers the hub LAN address.

connection.s_callback.callbackPort.label: Callback port
